newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Chicago, Atlanta had busiest airports last year.
newsitem.headline: Chicago, Atlanta had busiest airports last year.

text.p: O'Hare Airport in Chicago remained the world's busiest passenger airport last year and the Summer Olympics helped make Atlanta's Hartsfield Airport the second busiest, an industry group said Thursday.
The Airports Council International said O'Hare held its position as the world's busiest passenger airport with just over 52 million people passing through, up 2.7 percent from 1995.
Atlanta recorded nearly 48 million travellers, surpassing Los Angeles with 44 million and London's Heathrow with just over 42 million.
The world's busiest cargo airport remained Memphis, home base for Federal Express Corp., a major national and international package courier.
Some 1.4 million metric tons of cargo passed through Memphis, an increase of 10.2 percent.
Los Angeles was next with 1.25 million tons, followed by Miami with 1.24 million and New York's Kennedy with 1.19 million tons.
